A Certificate of Operation shall be required, as per Section 28-117.1, for the following assembly occupancies:
   1.   Indoor assembly occupancies used or intended for use by 75 persons or more, including open spaces at 20 feet (6096 mm) or more above or below grade plane, such as roofs or roof terraces.
   2.   Outdoor assembly occupancies used and intended for use by 200 persons or more.
Section BC 304: Business Group B
